catalog_item_source_ck.name: catalog_item_source_ck
catalog_item_source_ck.value: length(btrim("catalog_item"."key")) > 0 AND length(btrim("catalog_item"."label")) > 0 AND length(btrim("catalog_item"."domain")) > 0 AND length(btrim("catalog_item"."source_page")) > 0

catalog_release_source_ck.name: catalog_release_source_ck
catalog_release_source_ck.value: length(btrim("catalog_release"."publisher")) > 0 AND length(btrim("catalog_release"."title")) > 0 AND length(btrim("catalog_release"."version")) > 0 AND length(btrim("catalog_release"."revision")) > 0 AND "catalog_release"."url" LIKE 'https://%' AND "catalog_release"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'

completed_checkup_target_ck.name: completed_checkup_target_ck
completed_checkup_target_ck.value: ("completed_checkup"."individual_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("completed_checkup"."release_id" IS NOT NULL AND "completed_checkup"."key" IS NOT NULL)

notification_recipient_ck.name: notification_recipient_ck
notification_recipient_ck.value: ("notification_outbox"."channel" = 'IN_APP' AND "notification_outbox"."recipient_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notification_outbox"."address" IS NULL) OR ("notification_outbox"."channel" <> 'IN_APP' AND "notification_outbox"."address" IS NULL)

who_row_sd_ck.name: who_row_sd_ck
who_row_sd_ck.value: "who_reference_row"."sd_neg3" > 0 AND "who_reference_row"."sd_neg3" < "who_reference_row"."sd_neg2" AND "who_reference_row"."sd_neg2" < "who_reference_row"."sd_neg1" AND "who_reference_row"."sd_neg1" < "who_reference_row"."sd_0" AND "who_reference_row"."sd_0" < "who_reference_row"."sd_1" AND "who_reference_row"."sd_1" < "who_reference_row"."sd_2" AND "who_reference_row"."sd_2" < "who_reference_row"."sd_3"
